$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for this configuration file.

actionpath.description: Path to the GitHub Action metadata file. Use this when your action file is not located at the repository root or uses a custom name.

readmepath.description:
Path to the README file that actdocs will generate or update. - Supports Markdown files ending in `.md` or `.mdx`.
- Defaults to `README.md` at the repository root.

readmePlaceholder.description: Placeholder marker used by actdocs to define the auto-generated section in the README where the same marker is used for both boundaries.

format.description:
Controls how content is rendered in output.

- `section` (default): Renders each item as a titled documentation block.
- `table`: Renders content in a structured table format.

headingLevel.description: Markdown heading level used for generated section titles like `Inputs` and `Outputs`.

inputsTitle.description: Title used for the inputs section in the generated README.

outputsTitle.description: Title used for the outputs section in the generated README.

propertyNames.description: A unique identifier used as the key. It must start with a letter or "_" and can contain alphanumeric characters, "-" or "_".

description.description:
A human-readable description of the input.

Supports **Markdown (.md)** formatting, including:
- headings (`## Heading`)
- lists
- code blocks

May be provided as a single string or an array of strings (which will be joined with newlines).

required.description: Whether this input must be provided by the user. Set this to true when the action cannot function without this value.

default.description: A fallback value used when the workflow does not provide this input. Do not set this when the input is marked as required.

deprecationMessage.description: A warning message shown to users when this input is used. Use this to communicate deprecations and suggest alternatives.

inputs.description: Definitions of inputs supported by the action. Each key represents an input name, and its value describes how the input behaves.

propertyNames.description: A unique identifier used as the key. It must start with a letter or "_" and can contain alphanumeric characters, "-" or "_".

description.description:
A human-readable description of the input.

Supports **Markdown (.md)** formatting, including:
- headings (`## Heading`)
- lists
- code blocks

May be provided as a single string or an array of strings (which will be joined with newlines).

outputs.description: Definitions of outputs produced by the action. Each key represents an output name exposed to downstream workflow steps.
